study: Accurate-CE RMS first-joint-failure replication and localization

historical_reference.role: Separately identified historical pilot; same event analysis as prospective failures

rationale: Preserve the historical CPU backend and PyTorch2.13.0. Initialization and historical event replay are bitwise exact under this environment.

model.split: Original generate_modular_addition_data with per-seed local torch.Generator permutation
model.normalization: gain-free RMS before attention, MLP, and readout

objective: Existing cancellation-resistant accurate_cross_entropy from initialization, preserving float32 logits and loss arithmetic

monitoring.train: Every state from initialization, using full training-batch logits used for the next update; exact correct/total counts logged
monitoring.test: Every100updates and whenever training accuracy is below90% after grokking confirmation; terminal100000 also scheduled
monitoring.grokking_confirmation: Six consecutive scheduled test evaluations >=95%; confirmation at sixth, initial point of streak retained separately
monitoring.failure: First subsequent state with both train and test accuracy <90%
monitoring.stopping: First joint failure after confirmation or step100000

checkpointing.event_preceding_every_update: In-memory full model, optimizer and RNG snapshot retained after confirmation; written at event
checkpointing.gpu_rng: CPU execution uses no GPU RNG; fields explicitly null
checkpointing.technical_interruption: Preserve logs and recover exact model/optimizer/RNG snapshot. Any replay overlap must be documented before resuming.

event_analysis.replay: Restore immediately preceding checkpoint; perform complete update on CPU; exact tensor equality for model, optimizers and torch RNG; full extended RNG for prospective states; verify event measurements
event_analysis.derivative: Accurate float32 derivative compared with analytic float64 mean-CE derivative evaluated at identical stored float32 training logits. Report absoluteL2/max, relativeL2, reference norm, class-sum residual and saved arrays.
event_analysis.swaps: All8old/new combinations in embeddings,hidden,readout order; native float32 train/test correct counts and accurateCE; full-batch training and1024-chunk test evaluations
event_analysis.decoder_features: Forward-pre-hook on unembedding; includes final RMS; frozen native float32 features converted tofloat64 for fitting

decoder.validation_indices: Freeze before probe fitting; preserve within seed across checkpoints
decoder.selection: Lowest validation cross entropy; tie uses smaller lambda
decoder.transforms: Fit on inner training examples per candidate and original training examples for refit
decoder.unregularized_control: Reuse selected lambda0 fit; otherwise separate lambda0 fit with same procedure
decoder.convergence: All candidate and refit statuses, iteration/function counts, final gradients retained
